module: Flowgraph node "Three Element Select" (default category, once + singleActive): lets the player choose between three elements (UI navigation 'menu.threeElementSelect'). Inputs: flow, "reset", "description", then for i = 1..3: "veh<i>image", "veh<i>name", "veh<i>desc". Outputs: "pick1", "pick2", "pick3".
notes: Showing two of these at the same time will break everything (todo from the code).
started() sets self.pinOut.flow to true, but this node has no "flow" output pin (error if called).

buttonPushed.desc: Sets the chosen pick output to true, the others to false.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

getCmd.desc: Returns the Lua command that calls buttonPushed(action) back.

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

openDialogue.desc: Builds the three elements (image, name, description, button code) and navigates to 'menu.threeElementSelect'.

reset.desc: Resets done, open and _active to false.

started.desc: Closes the screen then writes pinOut.flow (see notes).

work.desc: Handles reset; opens the screen when the input flow is active.
